name: Corrupted Kor Gem
summary: Near Blackfathom Deeps, naga rites taint Kor gems. Sorcerers prize their arcane power, though the corruption must be cleansed before a gem can be used in righteous smithing.

sections.title: Vessels of Tainted Power
sections.body: Kor gems hold great stores of magic, making them useful to sorcerers and enchanted smiths. Near the ruins of Blackfathom Deeps, naga oracles and tide priestesses claim the stones for their rites. Their enchantments corrupt each gem with magic from the sea. The taint leaves the stone's latent power intact, so those seeking a potent focus still look among the naga.

sections.title: Purification and Smithing
sections.body: Thundris Windweaver requires a Corrupted Kor Gem to be purified before it is taken to Jordan Stilwell. In Auberdine, the night elf cleanses the naga's evil magic. He assures the paladin that the gem's power remains intact for the blacksmith's ritual.

faq.q: What is a Kor Gem used for?
faq.answer: Kor gems hold arcane energy for spellcasters. Skilled blacksmiths can set them into enchanted weapons to channel magic.

faq.q: Where are Corrupted Kor Gems found?
aliases: where to find corrupted kor gem
faq.answer: Naga spellcasters carry Corrupted Kor Gems around Blackfathom Deeps, both within and outside its ancient ruins on the Ashenvale and Darkshore border. Blackfathom Tide Priestesses and Blackfathom Oracles bear them.

faq.q: Why must the gem be purified?
faq.answer: Naga rites fill the gems with foul magic. Before a gem can be worked into an arm, a master of nature or light such as Thundris Windweaver must purge the evil.

faq.q: Does cleansing the gem preserve its power?
faq.answer: Yes. Thundris Windweaver assures the paladin that cleansing leaves the gem's power intact for Jordan Stilwell's ritual.

angles.text: As a paladin, you must recover and purify a Kor Gem to forge a sacred armament. In doing so, you prove you can face evil and cleanse darkness into righteous strength.
As a night elf, you know the danger naga relics bring to Darkshore. Scholars such as Thundris Windweaver preserve the knowledge needed to cleanse the ancient stones.
